dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The visible base of the leading edge indicates an approximate 45 to 50-degree upward slope relative to the horizontal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, wide-radius convex arc extending from the dorsal blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak profile with a thickness-to-length ratio of approximately 1:1.2 visible from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct transition point forming an obtuse interior angle of approximately 135 degrees between the melon and the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint dark circular markings and vertical linear striations are visible on the mid-to-lower lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast cyan-colored luminance pattern consisting of a large dorsal patch posterior to the fin and a longitudinal jagged streak along the lateral midline.
